title: Context Glossary
description: Domain glossary generated from CONTEXT.md by the domain-business-modeling skill. Consumed by context-lineage-generator.

sourceRepo.description: Slug of the analyzed repository this glossary describes.

contextDescription.description: The paragraph under the H1, when present.

stableId.description: Join key across all pipeline stages.

term.description: The canonical term, verbatim from the markdown.

avoid.description: Words this concept is deliberately not called, and words it is deliberately not confused with. Downstream stages classify each entry as synonym, disambiguation, or missing concept — see docs/adr/0006-avoid-three-relationships.md.

source.description: Where this term came from, when it did not originate in this glossary: the artifact and candidate that proposed it. Omit for terms derived directly from the analyzed repository. Accepted candidates drop their originating row, so this is the only surviving record of their provenance — see docs/adr/0005-single-gate-in-glossary-stage.md.

group.description: Thematic subheading the term appears under, when the glossary is grouped.
